subject.title: i18n(fr): expand French glossary with page titles and common terms

question: Should maintainers accept this French glossary terminology as-is, or require publish-repo French reconciliation inspection before merge?
rationale: Automated review can validate schema, ownership boundary, and current-main non-redundancy, but it cannot fully approve native French terminology choices or unseen regenerated docs output.

options.title: Accept glossary terms
options.body: Merge after ordinary maintainer docs review because the PR updates the correct source-of-truth glossary surface and matches the loader contract.

options.title: Inspect generated output first
options.body: Run or inspect the publish-repo French reconciliation before merge if maintainers want to approve the exact generated page wording.

options.title: Request terminology edits
options.body: Ask the contributor to adjust specific French terms if maintainers disagree with the chosen glossary renderings.

recommendation.title: Accept glossary terms
recommendation.body: Merge after ordinary maintainer docs review because the PR updates the correct source-of-truth glossary surface and matches the loader contract.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main docs i18n history and scoped docs guide ownership make this the best available routing candidate for the terminology/source-of-truth decision.
